prompt: Single game hero sprite: a heavy-metal centaur warrior: the upper body of a broad-shouldered man rising from the body of a strong four-legged horse, top-heavy with huge shoulders and arms, a small head and a compact horse body on sturdy short legs with big hooves; ash-grey skin and a darker charcoal-grey horse coat and tail; a few pieces of dark gunmetal armour only: one big spiked shoulder plate, a simple chest strap and plates on the horse's chest; large heavy steel gauntlets on both hands (a key feature); a long war scythe with a dark iron haft and a bright polished steel curved blade with a cold blue-white edge, clearly brighter than the grey skin; the outlines are dark purple and a small violet accent glows in the eyes and on the blade's edge. Three-quarter view facing down-right, as if moving toward the bottom-right of the screen. Neutral idle stance: the four hooves planted, the scythe standing upright beside him, its haft gripped in one gauntleted hand, the blade at the top. Full body including all four legs, the tail and the whole scythe, centered, filling about 70% of the frame. Background: one flat solid pure magenta color (#FF00FF) everywhere, no gradient, no ground, no shadow, no scenery, no text, no border. Do not use magenta or pink anywhere on the subject. Stylized 2D vector cartoon game art for a top-down fantasy tower defense game, designed to read at about 64 pixels tall. Simple design: big clear shapes and a strong silhouette; small details are left out or merged into larger shapes; faces, hands, armour and clothing are suggested with a few lines, never rendered in fine detail. Stylized, exaggerated cartoon proportions, not realistic anatomy (about 2.5 to 4 heads tall): the parts that express the character's role are enlarged and the rest is shrunk, so the silhouette reads at 64 pixels. High top-down camera tilted about 60 degrees; light comes from the top-left.
